text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: smart-routing service reports spike in fallback loops and elevated error rate (service: routing-manager). Ticket INC-4982. Error rate ~18%, P50 latency x2. Auto-escalation to on-call created.

maya: On-call (maya) — I'm on it. Any immediate customer alerts?

samir: I see traces showing a lot of requests from eu-west being repeatedly routed to the us-east model variant and then falling back, causing KV cache churn. Looks like variants are oscillating.

eli: Was there a config push this morning? We deployed config-service v2.3.0 around 06:14UTC that changed schema validation for routing entries.

chloe: Confirmed. v2.3.0 deprecated the `fallback_variant` key in favor of `fallback_policy`. Legacy keys are ignored by the new validator and the runtime now falls back to the global default `fallback_to_global`. That default is different from previous behavior (which was effectively "no fallback"). Partial rollouts + mixed config led to unexpected global fallthrough.

samir: That would explain variant mismatch. Can we do a quick stopgap to pin affected routes to the correct variant?

maya: Yes — applying per-route override for impacted customers now. Using rwctl to set a temporary override.

maya: Command I'm running:```bash
# pin route 4231 to eu-west-variant-v2
rwctl routing override set --route-id 4231 --key fallback_variant --value eu-west-variant-v2 --ttl 1h
# list active overrides
rwctl routing override list --filter route=4231
```

eli: I can push a small compatibility shim to config-service to map `fallback_variant` -> `fallback_policy: pin_variant` for 24h. That avoids touching many routes. If we do that, we should still set overrides for the top-impacted customers first.

chloe: Agreed. Plan: 1) Immediate per-route overrides for top 5 affected customers. 2) Hotfix shim in config-service to restore legacy semantics for 24 hours. 3) Roll back v2.3.0 if the shim causes any regressions. 4) Runbook updates + alert changes.

maya: Applying overrides now for customers A, B, C, D, E — status: done for A/B/C, D/E in progress. Monitoring metrics... error rate dropping to ~1.7% for pinned routes. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Update INC-4982 status -> mitigated (partial). Postmortem channel created: #postmortems-4982

samir: Can someone capture the fast root-cause summary for the postmortem? I'll start notes. Root cause: config schema change (v2.3.0) removed/renamed `fallback_variant` -> `fallback_policy` without a compatible migration. The runtime default for the new field is `fallback_to_global` which changes routing semantics, causing cross-variant fallbacks and a feedback loop under partial config rollouts.

chloe: Customer impact summary: three customers saw ~2% request failures and latency increase for approx 26 minutes. No data leak. CS notified; engineering to provide timeline.

maya: Mitigations completed at 06:43UTC: overrides applied, shim deployed to config-service at 06:47UTC. Observability shows error rate back to baseline ~0.5%.

samir: Handoff — I'm taking next shift to drive follow-ups. Remaining action items assigned: [samir] revert or properly migrate v2.3.0, [eli] add schema compatibility layer tests and CI gate, [chloe] update routing runbook and add alert to detect semantic changes in defaults, [maya] verify rollback plan and coordinate with CS for customer comms.

maya: Acknowledged. I'm adding runbook snippets for emergency override commands and a short script to detect mixed-key routes.

samir: I'll own the postmortem (INC-4982). Initial severity: Sev2, customer-visible degradation. We'll propose process change: require compatibility shim or migration window when deprecating routing keys.

chloe: Noted — also going to add a synthetic check that ensures route-level defaults don't change semantics across deploys (compare pre/post default behavior).

maya: Handoff complete — paging cleared. Next on-call: @samir. If anything re-escalates ping mobile.

incident-bot: Incident INC-4982 updated: mitigated -> monitoring.

samir: A few quick snippets for postmortem timeline:```text
06:14UTC config-service v2.3.0 deploy
06:18UTC routing anomalies detected by alerts
06:20UTC pagerduty escalation, on-call paged
06:24UTC traced cross-region fallback loop
06:30UTC per-route overrides applied to top customers
06:43UTC error rate near baseline
06:47UTC config-service shim deployed
07:10UTC monitoring stable, incident moved to monitoring
```

maya: Good notes. I'll attach the override audit logs and tracer spans to the postmortem doc.

chloe: I'll notify product + trust teams to prepare customer comms.

samir: Thanks all. I'll follow up with a proposed migration policy and the PR for compatibility tests. Closing handover now.

maya: :white_check_mark: All clear from my side.
